screen.mineagent.help.start.1: 1. Configure protocol, any model ID, endpoint and API key in Configure & Create.

screen.mineagent.help.start.3: 3. Open Companion Chat to give goals and review replies.

screen.mineagent.help.behavior.1: Reflex controls apply to the companion shown in Companion Chat.

screen.mineagent.help.behavior.3: Stored companions and memory are restored when their owner rejoins.
